item.title: Mr. Behboodi, greetings. A little before the 40-day war, when the possibility of a US attack increas...
item.description: Mr. Behboodi, greetings. A little before the 40-day war, when the possibility of a US attack increased, Shahrood's 258th Commando Brigade was sent south. Now that the discussion of a ground attack is on the table, the 158th Commando Brigade (another subordinate of the 58th Division) has also been sent south towards Jask. In previous weeks, Azerbaijan's 25th Commando Brigade was also sent to Isfahan, so that if, for example, the US wanted to do something there, they would prevent it. The 92nd Division and other units were also dispatched south one by one... But when you saw their equipment, you really didn't know what to say. They think they are going to fight like in World War I. With these capabilities, they will at best become America's recess. Perhaps the human resources are not bad, but given their capabilities, even if the entire Iranian army is taken, they will at best become target practice for America and Israel. The army has not yet openly and extensively joined the people, but they should know that if they remain by the side of the Akhundi Dzhahhak regime, they will all be riddled with bullets like drinking water. And the people will send nothing but spit and curses for them. When they die, no one will say hero or martyr so-and-so ... Everyone will say they became a sacrifice for the Akhunds... Except for a few favored commanders, the army personnel have always been deprived, and they only beg with their blood wherever they want. Even if a hundred thousand people from the army are killed, it will mean nothing to these officials of the system. I don't know when the army will wake up? These people are leaving. Don't get burned pointlessly in a losing game. The time to join the people is now. Going in front of the camera and begging for your rights will give you nothing. Join the nation and do something practical in this regard. Otherwise, they will make the army a sacrifice for the terrorist Sepah too... Army personnel, come to your senses, this regime has no hesitation in sacrificing you too. If a person wants to sacrifice themselves for a cause, at least let it be for their country's people, not for a few English Akhunds who are riding on your back... Of course, army personnel face challenges and dangers related to information security, but they should also know that they don't have time forever. Join the people before it's too late...
